description.value: A small municipal campground on the shore of Slocan Lake in the quiet village of Silverton; the 'Lakeside' name and lake-town setting suggest a scenic overnight, though amenity details are unconfirmed as the town website is offline.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The specific camping page URL (http://www.silverton.ca/rec/Camping.html) returns a 404, so no detailed amenity data is available from it. However, the Village of Silverton homepage confirms the campground is an active facility operated by the municipality, with online reservations available ('Reserve your spot and enjoy Silverton's natural beauty year-round. BOOK NOW!'). OSM tags supply capacity=20, fee=yes, internet_access=no, and operator=Village of Silverton, which are the only other confirmed data points.
concerns: The OSM website URL (http://www.silverton.ca/rec/Camping.html) returns a 404; amenity details are unverifiable until the URL is corrected.

The village office address shown on the website (421 Lake Avenue, Silverton, BC V0G 1S0) differs from the OSM campground address (521 Turner Street) — the Lake Avenue address likely belongs to the municipal office, not the campground itself.
No phone number is recorded in OSM; the number on the website (250-358-2472) appears to be the general municipal office line.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, publicly operated municipal campground confirmed active by the Village of Silverton website with online booking; the 404 on the specific camping sub-page is a broken link, not evidence of closure.

wow_evidence: small municipal campground on the shore of Slocan Lake; amenity details are unconfirmed
